Article Title: Our FTAs fair & equitable, protect farmers, MSMEs, labour sector: Govt to NDA MPs
Article Text:
Two Cabinet ministers have told BJP-led NDA MPs that govt has engaged in “fair, equitable and balanced” trade agreements

NEW DELHI: Two Cabinet ministers have told BJP-led NDA MPs that govt has engaged in “fair, equitable and balanced” trade agreements with large, high income and complementary economies, unlike the UPA dispensation that signed FTAs with mostly "small, competing and low per capita economies" like SAARC and ASEAN, in what is being seen as the governing alliance’s efforts to ramp up its counter to opposition’s criticism over the issue.At the NDA parliamentary party meeting, commerce minister Piyush Goyal and fisheries minister Lalan Singh spoke on India’s free trade agreements and the growth in the fisheries sector, asserting that govt has ensured the protection of the interests of farmers, fishermen, MSMEs and the labour sector.The FTAs under the NDA govt will be a driver of the Indian economy through global trade, Goyal's presentation said.India’s pre-2014 FTAs covered GDPs of USD 10 trillion compared to USD 60 trillion under the FTAs being entered by the NDA govt, they said.The standout presence in the meeting, which was attended by PM Narendra Modi, was the breakaway faction of 20 TMC MPs, whose merger with Nationalist Citizens Party of India is awaiting recognition from Speaker Om Birla. Their maiden participation announced their formal entry in NDA.Sources said the presentation on FTA (free trade agreement) at the closed door meeting accused Congress-led UPA of entering into trade deal with other countries without consulting stakeholders that ended up adversely affecting the economy.With Rahul Gandhi repeatedly accusing govt of selling out the country’s interests in its framework of trade agreement, whose details are still being negotiated, with the US, NDA is expected to step up its offensive, more so as the opposition may raise the issue in Parliament.Lalan SIngh said total fish production has increased from 95.79 LT in 2013-14 to 197.75 LT in 2024 25, with the country becoming second largest fish producers with a global share of 8%. Total sea food exports have doubled from Rs 30,213 cr to Rs 62,408 cr."Despite US tariffs, India’s seafood exports showed resilience, rising from Rs 62,408 crore in FY 2024-25 to Rs 73,890 crore in FY 2025–26 (an increase of Rs 11,482 crore)," a presentation said, adding the European Union, the UK, New Zealand, Australia, Japan, Russia, South East Asia and Middle East are emerging as new markets.While the share of exports to the US reduced by 14% in value but it was offset by seafood exports to new markets.Another presentation said, govt has received "committed investments" of USD 100 billions from the European Free Trade Association and USD 20 billion from New Zealand.
Article Summary: Commerce minister piyush goyal and fisheries minister lalan singh spoke on india’s free trade agreements and the growth in the fisheries sector. The ftas under the nda govt will be a driver of the indian economy through global trade, goyal's presentation said.

Article Title: 'Deeply concerning': In UNSC, India strongly condemns attacks on commercial ships near Hormuz
Article Text:
Ambassador Parvathaneni Harish said the recent escalation after a brief lull in fighting was deeply worrying.

NEW DELHI: India has called for an immediate de-escalation of tensions in West Asia following a fresh escalation of hostilities in the region, while strongly condemning recent attacks on commercial vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz. New Delhi said attacks on civilian shipping must stop and free navigation through international waterways should be restored at the earliest.Addressing a United Nations Security Council open debate on the situation in the Middle East on Tuesday, India's permanent representative to the UN, ambassador Parvathaneni Harish, said the recent rise in violence after a brief pause in the conflict was "deeply concerning.""After a brief pause in the ongoing conflict in the region, there has been a worrying resumption of attacks and escalation of hostilities. This is deeply concerning and India calls for an immediate de-escalation of tensions," Harish said.India also strongly condemned attacks on several vessels, including GFS Galaxy, MT Al Bahiyah and MT Mombasa, during their transit through the Strait of Hormuz earlier this month.The attacks affected Indian nationals, with one Indian killed, another reported missing and several others injured, including some seriously."India has consistently condemned acts of violence targeting seafarers and disrupting free and safe navigation through international waterways like the Strait of Hormuz," Harish said.He added, "The targeting of commercial shipping and civilian infrastructure in the region must end, and free and unimpeded navigation and commerce through the international waterways in the region, in keeping with international law, must be restored at the earliest."The remarks come amid the conflict involving the United States, Israel and Iran. According to the United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific, Iran declared the Strait of Hormuz closed again on July 11 following attacks on commercial vessels that began on July 6. Daily vessel transits, which exceeded 100 before the conflict and had recovered to 49 by July 7, fell to as low as eight to 15 by the middle of July.Harish said West Asia is a region of immense importance for India as the country's trade, energy supply chains and economic interests are closely linked to it. India has annual bilateral trade of around $180 billion with the region, cumulative foreign direct investment of more than $31 billion and receives over $52 billion in remittances from Gulf Cooperation Council countries.He also noted that around 10 million Indians live and work in the Gulf region and said, "Their safety and well-being are a key priority for us."India also urged the international community not to lose sight of the humanitarian crisis in Gaza while focusing on developments in the Strait of Hormuz."The loss of civilian lives and destruction of civilian infrastructure are pressing concerns that the international community must act on immediately, with a deep sense of urgency," Harish said.Reaffirming India's long-standing position on the Israel-Palestine issue, he said, "India believes that a sovereign, independent and viable State of Palestine living side by side in peace with Israel, within secure and recognised borders, is essential to a comprehensive and lasting solution."Harish added that India's development assistance to Palestine amounts to around $175 million.On Yemen, India reaffirmed its commitment to the country's unity, sovereignty and territorial integrity and rejected any interference in its internal affairs."We further condemn attacks by Houthis on maritime navigation. The protection of the Bab al-Mandab Strait and the Southern Red Sea is a shared international responsibility and is a global interest," Harish said.On Lebanon, India said peacekeepers serving with the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon operate under challenging circumstances and should never become targets. Harish said India strongly condemns all attacks on UNIFIL peacekeepers and added, "Further, it is important to be ready for a post-UNIFIL scenario, and in this context, the Lebanese Armed Forces must receive requisite support and assistance."
Article Summary: Ambassador parvathaneni harish said the recent escalation after a brief lull in fighting was deeply worrying. New delhi said attacks on civilian shipping must stop and free navigation through international waterways should be restored at the earliest. India strongly condemned attacks on several vessels, including gfs galaxy, mt al bahiyah and mt mombasa.

Article Title: India slams POK elections, Pakistan's claims over Indus Valley legacy
Article Text:
MEA slams Pakistan

India slammed Pakistan for the Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (POK) polls, saying the "cosmetic electoral exercise" was just an attempt to camouflage the illegal occupation of Indian territory.Ministry of external affairs (MEA) reiterated India's "consistent, clear and well known" position that the entire Union territories of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh, including the areas currently under Pakistan's illegal and forcible occupation, are integral and inalienable parts of India."We have seen reports regarding the so-called legislative assembly elections being conducted in POK...the current cosmetic electoral exercise is nothing but an attempt by Pakistan to camouflage its illegal occupation and hide its grave human rights violations in the region," said MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal.Asked about Pakistan's efforts to reclaim the Indus Valley Civilisation legacy, the official again cited Pakistan's backing of terrorism, saying a country which has been promoting cross-border terrorism, religious fundamentalism and violence for decades, cannot have any claim to any pluralistic cultural legacy.
Article Summary: Mea slams pakistan for the pakistan-occupied kashmir (pok) polls. "cosmetic electoral exercise is nothing but an attempt by pakistan to camouflage its illegal occupation and hide its grave human rights violations in the region," said mea spokesperson randhir jaiswal.

Article Title: 'Removed in error': Meta responds after PM Modi's video was blocked on Facebook; govt summons company official
Article Text:
Meta admits that PM Modi's video was 'removed' in error

Poll Vote & Share your view What is more important to prevent exam irregularities? Stricter laws Better exam security 3k+ users shared opinion today 5k+ users already voted today 3k+ users shared opinion today Share Opinion

NEW DELHI: Meta on Tuesday admitted that Prime Minister Narendra Modi 's first selfie video on Facebook , meant to address GenZ over NEET paper leak, was taken down briefly due to an "error"."The content was removed in error and has since been restored," said a Meta spokesperson, as quoted by ANI. The govt also summoned Meta official in light of the event.The ministry of electronics and information technology (MeitY) summoned Meta's global head of public policy, according to PTI sources.This comes as PM Modi 's video was "unavailable" for a little time on Facebook but was later restored.The video was PM Modi assuring that the government will bring in more strict actions against paper leaks. In a late night video message, PM had said that the Union Cabinet will discuss these stringent measures in Parliament and the government will try to get the Bill passed.His message came amid massive nationwide protests at the time against alleged irregularities in the NEET UG examination. "I know that paper leak is not an ordinary issue. It is very painful for lakh of students and their guardians," he said.Further talking about the bill on fast track courts he had added, "On the 19th July, the results were declared. I directed the departments today to establish a fast-track court. The departments presented me with the resolution late at night. This resolution, along with the provision for a fast-track court and harsh punishment, will be discussed in the cabinet tomorrow. After the suggestions of cabinet colleagues, it will be finalised, and since the second week of Parliament is starting from Monday, efforts will be made to get that bill passed in the House as soon as possible. "
Article Summary: Meta admits that pm modi's video was'removed' in error. The govt also summoned meta official in light of the event. This comes as pm modi's video was "unavailable" for a little time on facebook but was later restored.

Article Title: UK company in spotlight as Nishikant Dubey vows 'disclosure' in Parliament
Article Text:
File photo: BJP MP Nishikant Dubey

NEW DELHI: BJP MP Nishikant Dubey Tuesday said he will soon make a disclosure in Parliament about a UK-registered company allegedly linked to an Indian MP, igniting speculation over who could be the target."Which Indian politician is a director in Backops Limited (UK)? Which companies have their address at 2 Frognal Way, London NW3 6XE? What is the connection of that Indian neta with Brian Lovegrove and Ulrik McKnight? Everything will be revealed inside Parliament," Dubey posted on X, piquing interest and sparking buzz hinting that Parliament might witness yet another showdown.Talking to reporters in Parliament complex, the Godda MP elaborated on his claim by saying that two individuals, Brian Lovegrove and Ulrik McKnight, linked to Backops Limited, were associated with hundreds of companies, including a few TV channels, all registered at the same address: a claim that implied that Backops Limited was not a genuine business enterprise.The BJP MP said that the MP in question had registered Backops Limited in the UK in 2003."I intend to raise all these matters in Parliament: Who is this MP, and how did they register this company? What is their relationship with Lovegrove and McKnight, and what role does '2 Frognal Way' play in the 'tukde-tukde gang'?" Dubey said.
Article Summary: Bjp mp nishikant dubey says he will soon make a disclosure in parliament about a uk-registered company allegedly linked to an indian mp. Dubey: "which indian politician is a director in backops limited (uk)? Which companies have their address at 2 frognal way, london nw3 6xe?

Article Title: 'I regret it': Mehbooba Mufti claims Jantar Mantar remark a slip of tongue, apologises
Article Text:
File photo: PDP chief Mehbooba Mufti

SRINAGAR: Under fire for her Jantar Mantar remark that appeared to justify the use of force in Kashmir on grounds of “militancy”, PDP president Mehbooba Mufti Tuesday apologised, but claimed it was a slip of tongue and accused governing NC and chief minister Omar Abdullah of deliberately misinterpreting her comment.“If my words have hurt or upset my people, who consider me one of their own and often hold me accountable even over small matters, then I sincerely apologise,” Mehbooba said. “If they have been hurt by my statement, I regret it.”Explaining the controversial remark, she said: “One clip from my interaction, in which I used the word ‘banta hai’ (understandable) while referring to militancy, went viral. I said that in haste. The remark was interpreted differently.”While talking to reporters at Jantar Mantar on July 23 during the CJP protest, Mehbooba is heard saying in a widely circulated video: “We have seen this (use of force against protesters) for the first time in Delhi. We have witnessed it in Kashmir for many years. Magar wahan militancy hai, uska ek banta hai (But militancy exists there, so it is understandable).”With Omar lapping up the remark and accusing her of supporting the repression of Kashmiris, the former J&K chief minister clarified she meant to say ‘bahana’ (excuse) banta hai, but in a slip of tongue, said “banta hai”.“The video circulating is genuine, but the meaning being attributed to my words is not,” she said.NC, however, rejected her apology and clarification. “The only appropriate response is a clear and unconditional apology to every Kashmiri who was hurt, especially the victims of pellet injuries,” party spokesperson Tanvir Sadiq said.“Also, apologise for your alliance with BJP and for bringing them to power in Jammu & Kashmir. Everything else said today was simply an attempt to divert attention from your original remarks,” he added.
Article Summary: Mehbooba mufti apologises for her jantar mantar remark that appeared to justify the use of force in kashmir on grounds of "militancy" pdp president claims it was a slip of tongue and accused governing nc and chief minister omar abdullah of deliberately misinterpreting her comment.

Article Title: India is second-largest sailor supplier in world
Article Text:
File photo: Ships in the sea

NEW DELHI: With a 12.2% share of global seafaring workforce, India has become the world's second-largest supplier of sailors, according to BIMCO-ICS Seafarer Workforce Report 2026. The Philippines continues to be the largest supplier of seafarers globally.The report published every five years is widely regarded by the global maritime industry as the most authoritative assessment of seafarer supply and demand. As per the report, share of Indian sailors has doubled in the past five years."BIMCO-ICS report is the most credible and every maritime nation follows this. India's strength is particularly evident in the officer cadre. We supply over 1.4 lakh officers, accounting for 13.4% of the world's officer workforce, while 1.7 lakh ratings represent 11.29% of the global ratings serving aboard merchant vessels," said an official.
Article Summary: India has become the world's second-largest supplier of sailors, according to bimco-ics seafarer workforce report 2026. Philippines continues to be the largest supplier of seafarers globally. The report published every five years is widely regarded by the global maritime industry as the most authoritative assessment of seafarer supply and demand.

Article Title: 'Every possible measure must be taken': Shipping minister Sarbananda Sonowal says no Indian seafarer should be caught in crossfire
Article Text:
Safety of Indian mariners remains the government’s top priority, Sonowal said

NEW DELHI: Amid escalating geopolitical tensions affecting key global shipping routes and posing risks to Indian sailors, shipping minister Sarbananda Sonowal Tuesday directed officials to ensure “no Indian seafarer finds himself caught in the crossfire of geopolitical conflict”.Safety of Indian mariners remains govt’s top priority, he said while chairing a high-level review meeting on the safety and welfare of Indian seafarers serving aboard merchant vessels in conflict-sensitive regions. The meeting was attended by officials from different departments and heads of Indian missions in Oman, Saudi Arabia, Iran, Russia and Ukraine.“No Indian seafarer should find himself caught in the crossfire of geopolitical conflict. Every possible measure must be taken to safeguard our seafarers, support their families and ensure timely assistance wherever required,” the minister said.Meanwhile, on X, Forward Seamen’s Union of India (FSUI) claimed that AMIR1, currently at Ukrainian port Chornomorsk with 15 crew on board, including 13 Indian seafarers, was trapped in a “terrible and life-threatening situation”.It said, “Repeated drone and missile attacks are being attempted in the immediate vicinity of the vessel.The crew is living under constant fear of a direct hit at any moment,” while appealing to authorities, shipowners, flag state, and govt to immediately secure their safety and arrange prompt repatriation.During the meeting, officials reviewed the prevailing security situation, maritime developments and the preparedness of Indian diplomatic missions.DG Shipping informed the minister that its 24x7 Seafarer Grievance and Assistance Cell remains fully operational. It added that to strengthen preparedness, the maritime regulator has asked Recruitment and Placement Service Licensees (RPSLs) to conduct structured pre-departure orientation programmes to familiarise seafarers with operational conditions, security protocols and evolving geopolitical risks in deployment areas.Recognising the psychological stress of prolonged deployment in volatile regions, Sonowal also directed officials to integrate mental health support into the seafarer welfare framework, including counselling services for seafarers and their families and greater transparency on operational risks before deployment.
Article Summary: Safety of indian mariners remains govt’s top priority, sarbananda sonowal said. Forward seamen's union of india claimed that amir1, currently at ukrainian port chornomorsk with 15 crew on board, including 13 indian seafarers, was trapped in a ‘terrible and life-threatening situation’

Article Title: Jammu and Kashmir: Army duo hurt in Uri accidental blast
Article Text:
File photo: Army personnel near LoC

SRINAGAR: Two Army jawans were injured in an accidental blast near the Line of Control in J&K’s Uri sector, a Srinagar-based defence spokesperson stated Tuesday.The blast occurred in Uri’s Kamalkote area, Lt Col M K Sahu said, adding that the duo was rushed to the Army’s Base Hospital at Badamibagh, Srinagar, for treatment.“They are both stable. There is no threat to life,” Sahu said.
Article Summary: The blast occurred in uri’s kamalkote area, lt col m k sahu said. He said the duo was rushed to the army's base hospital at badamibagh, srinagar, for treatment. “they are both stable. There is no threat to life,” he said.

Article Title: 13 Indians stranded aboard vessel in Ukraine amid repeated drone, missile attacks: Report
Article Text:
13 Indian seafarers trapped in vessel in Ukraine amid repeated drone, missile attacks

NEW DELHI: Thirteen Indian seafarers are among 15 crew members stranded on board a cargo vessel at Ukraine's Chornomorsk port, where repeated drone and missile attacks have placed the crew in what has been described as a "life-threatening situation", according to the Forward Seamen's Union of India (FSUI).In an urgent appeal posted on X, the union said the vessel, MV AMIR1, remains docked at Chornomorsk while hostilities continue in the surrounding area."MV AMIR1, currently at Ukrainian port Chornomorsk with 15 crew on board, including 13 Indian seafarers, is trapped in a terrible and life-threatening situation," it said.The union alleged that drone and missile attacks were being carried out in the immediate vicinity of the ship, leaving the crew in constant fear."Repeated drone and missile attacks are being attempted in the immediate vicinity of the vessel. The crew is living under constant fear of a direct hit at any moment," it said.The FSUI urged the shipowners, the vessel's flag state, the relevant authorities and the government to intervene immediately to ensure the crew's safety and facilitate their evacuation."We urgently appeal to all concerned authorities, shipowners, flag state, and the Government of India to immediately secure their safety and arrange prompt repatriation," the union said.Calling for urgent action, it added, "Indian seafarers must not be left as sitting targets in conflict zones. Act now."This comes a day after MEA raised concerns with Ukraine over the safety of Indian seafarers in the Black Sea. On Monday, the MEA summoned Ukraine's ambassador to India, Dr Oleksandr Polishchuk, following an attack on the merchant vessel MV OMORFI near the Ukrainian port of Odesa that had four Indian crew members on board.The MEA said the strike resulted in the death of an Indian national and condemned attacks on commercial shipping in the "strongest terms", calling them a threat to maritime safety, freedom of navigation and international commerce. It also urged Kyiv to ensure that commercial vessels carrying civilian seafarers are not targeted.
Article Summary: 13 indian seafarers trapped in vessel in ukraine amid repeated drone, missile attacks. Union alleges that drone and missile attacks were being carried out in the immediate vicinity of the ship. The crew is living under constant fear of a direct hit at any moment, it said.

Article Title: As Maldives president seeks SAARC summit, India says cooperation requires goodwill
Article Text:
Maldives President Mohamed Muizzu

With Maldives President Mohamed Muizzu calling for resumption of the biennial SAARC summit process, India reiterated Tuesday that it's Pakistan's support for cross-border terrorism that has blocked the intergovernmental organisation, which was conceived to build a connected and integrated South Asia. Muizzu in his Independence Day speech had also offered to act as a mediator between India and Pakistan to advance talks for an early leaders' summit.The last SAARC summit was held in 2014 in Nepal. The next summit that Pakistan was scheduled to host in 2016 could never take place as India pulled out because of the cross-border Uri terrorist attack. India has since maintained that regional cooperation under SAARC is adversely affected due to continued support to cross-border terrorism and interference in the internal affairs of member-states by Pakistan.Member-states like the Maldives, Bangladesh and Nepal have from time-to-time sought revival of the summit. "India favors strong regional cooperation and has been working towards it for several decades. Everyone in South Asia is aware of which country and what activities are responsible for stymieing SAARC," said MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal, adding that cooperation requires goodwill.The official was responding to a question about Muizzu's remarks in which he had sought "reactivation' of SAARC calling it vital for regional peace and security."We must bring matters to the point where the leaders of SAARC resume holding summits once again," said Muizzu."To those parties among whom differences have arisen in this regard, the Maldives calls upon you to set those matters aside, to prioritise friendship for the sake of regional development and regional peace, and to come to the negotiating table. Should the task prove challenging, the Maldives stands ready to take the initiative and act as a mediator to advance those discussions," said the president, adding that SAARC must be operationalised once again and that his administration would always champion peace.Muizzu also said that SAARC had brought numerous benefits to the region"However, we now witness a span of some nine years during which this organisation has been rendered, or has become, dysfunctional. Given that the foreign policy of the Maldives is structured...upon the principle that differences should be addressed through consultation, by bringing concerns to the discussion table, reaching resolutions, and moving forward in a manner that benefits all, the reactivation of SAARC is equally vital for regional peace and security," he added.Muizzu said his government's foreign policy was based on the conviction that if differences are left to be settled by violence and force, no resolution will ever be found.
Article Summary: Maldives president mohamed muizzu called for resumption of the biennial saarc summit process. India has maintained that regional cooperation under saarc is adversely affected due to continued support to cross-border terrorism and interference in the internal affairs of member-states.

Article Title: 'Clock it', 'delulu': How Gen Z lingo took over Parliament during anti-paper leak Bill debate
Article Text:
Parliament debates anti-paper leak Bill

'Clock it'

NDA MP's 'delulu' jibe at opposition

Priyanka's swipe at PM's videos

NEW DELHI: The Lok Sabha debate on the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, 2026 on Tuesday wasn't just about examination reforms and paper leaks. It also turned into an unexpected showcase of Gen Z vocabulary, with MPs across party lines dropping terms such as "clock it", "MIA", "FOMO" and "delulu" to sharpen their political arguments.From the treasury benches praising the Centre's reforms to the opposition attacking the government's handling of the NEET controversy, lawmakers reached for internet slang more commonly found on social media than in Parliament.BJP MP Bansuri Swaraj used the Gen Z phrase "clock it" — a slang term used to recognise something — while backing the proposed legislation.Speaking in favour of the Bill, she said, "Borrowing Gen Z's language, I would have to say that Modiji clocked it at providing this legislative solution."Calling the amendment a "transformative" step, Swaraj argued that it reflected the government's commitment to protecting the integrity of public examinations."I am standing in support of the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, 2026. This is a transformative amendment. Its necessity is not only evident, but it is also the demand of the present time. Bringing this amendment is proof of the sensitivity of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and his committed government.Speaker Sir, when a competitive examination is compromised, its impact is not limited to the candidate whose future is put at stake," she added.Shiv Sena MP Shrikant Lata Eknath Shinde turned to multiple Gen Z expressions to mock the opposition's protests over the NEET paper leak."I'd like to sum up the opposition's protest in Gen Z language. They were MIA (missing in action) for the first 37 days and did not go to Jantar Mantar. Then came FOMO (fear of missing out), so they held a protest outside the Prime Minister's residence. Finally, they became 'delulu' (delusional), believing the protesting students would join them—but no one did," Shinde said.Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, meanwhile, invoked Gen Z while targeting Prime Minister Narendra Modi's public outreach, arguing that young people could see through political messaging."If you want to win over the Gen Z, then making videos with different camera angles will not help. The prime minister needs to change the angle of his heart, not the angle of cameras," she said.She also urged the government to acknowledge the concerns raised by students over the examination controversy."Injustice has been done with youths under your government, accept the truth. Prime Minister Narendra Modi must take responsibility," Priyanka said.The Lok Sabha began discussing the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill at 2pm on Tuesday. Union Parliamentary affairs minister Kiren Rijiju said leaders from several parties, including the Congress, Samajwadi Party, DMK and NCP, had agreed to extend the debate from the originally scheduled six hours to eight hours.
Article Summary: Parliament debates anti-paper leak bill. Mps across party lines drop terms such as "mia", "fomo" and "delulu" to sharpen their political arguments. The lok sabha began discussing the public examinations (prevention of unfair means) amendment bill at 2pm on tuesday.

Article Title: 'Garlanded as if he won a war': Opposition attacks BJP over Dharmendra Pradhan's felicitation after resignation
Article Text:
Opposition attacks BJP over Dharmendra Pradhan's felicitation after resignation

What opposition said

NEW DELHI: A political row erupted in Parliament on Tuesday after the BJP's public felicitation of former Union education minister Dharmendra Pradhan, who resigned over the NEET-UG paper leak controversy, drew sharp criticism from the Opposition.Congress leaders accused the ruling party of celebrating a minister who resigned amid one of the country's biggest examination crises, saying he was welcomed "as if he were a superstar" and "had returned from a war against Pakistan".The controversy stems from Monday's scenes at the Parliament complex, where BJP and NDA MPs welcomed Pradhan with chants of "Dharmendra Pradhan zindabad", draped him in a traditional stole and cap, and escorted him into the House in a show of solidarity just two days after his resignation.Congress general secretary Priyanka Gandhi Vadra led the opposition's attack, calling it "shameful" that BJP MPs welcomed Pradhan in Parliament despite his resignation over the alleged NEET paper leak controversy."Don't you think it is shameful? Everyone saw the circumstances under which Dharmendra Pradhan resigned, but yesterday in the Parliament premises, he was welcomed as if he were a superstar!" she said.She also accused the government of continuing to target students despite the controversy."No one can trust the Modi government, because even today, students are being harassed. I saw some Instagram handles with photographs of women alleging that they did such and such thing...Do you want to engage in talks to resolve this matter or you are still after the students, wanting to suppress them? This is wrong," Priyanka Gandhi said.Speaking during the debate on the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, 2026 in the Lok Sabha, Congress MP Gaurav Gogoi echoed the criticism, saying Pradhan had been welcomed "as if he had returned from a war against Pakistan.""...21 children lost their lives; they committed suicide. The minister under whose watch 21 children lost their lives, when he resigned from his post and returned to the House yesterday, you garlanded him as if he had returned from a war against Pakistan," Gogoi said.The BJP's show of solidarity came after Pradhan resigned on Saturday following sustained protests over the alleged NEET paper leak. He has since been replaced by Union minister Prahlad Joshi.Meanwhile, the government has announced a series of measures to overhaul the examination system, including a high-powered task force headed by Nandan Nilekani, proposed amendments to the anti-paper leak law, and fast-track courts to deal with examination fraud cases.
Article Summary: Opposition attacks bjp over dharmendra pradhan's felicitation after resignation. Congress leaders accused the ruling party of celebrating a minister who resigned. They said he was welcomed "as if he were a superstar" and "had returned from a war against pakistan"

Article Title: 'Cosmetic exercise to camouflage illegal occupation': MEA rejects Pak-organised polls in PoK
Article Text:
MEA rejects Pak-organised polls in PoK

NEW DELHI: The ministry of external affairs on Tuesday dismissed the legislative assembly elections being held in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir (PoK), calling the exercise a "cosmetic" attempt by Islamabad to legitimise its "illegal occupation" of the region.Responding to reports on the polls, MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal reiterated that the entire Union territories of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh, including areas currently under Pakistan's control, are an integral part of India."We have seen reports regarding the so-called legislative assembly elections being conducted in the Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir... The entire union territories of Jammu, Kashmir and Ladakh, including the areas currently under illegal and forcible occupation of Pakistan, are integral parts of India," he said."The current cosmetic electoral exercise is nothing but an attempt by Pakistan to camouflage its illegal occupation and hide its grave human rights violations in the region. The ongoing mass protest in the Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir is the direct consequence of its economic exploitation, its denial of fundamental rights to the people and its administrative oppression," he added.PoK has been gripped by sustained protests for nearly two months, with demonstrators accusing the Pakistani authorities of political repression, economic exploitation and denying basic rights.The unrest has now begun to overshadow the region's legislative assembly elections, prompting the postponement of polling in two constituencies and drawing criticism from international rights groups.The latest escalation came on Monday when thousands of protesters marched towards Muzaffarabad after talks between the Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC) and the authorities collapsed, marking the 52nd day of the agitation.The protest movement is being spearheaded by the Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC), which says it is fighting for greater political freedoms, economic relief and an end to what it describes as administrative oppression by Pakistani authorities.
Article Summary: Mea rejects pak-organised polls in pok as a "cosmetic" attempt to legitimise its "illegal occupation" of the region. Pok has been gripped by sustained protests for nearly two months, with demonstrators accusing pakistani authorities of political repression, economic exploitation and denying basic rights.

Article Title: 'Not reasonable, issue far from settled': Govt rejects Meta's explanation on brief removal of PM Modi's Facebook video
Article Text:
Govt says Meta's response on briefly deleted video of PM was not enough

The Centre is not satisfied with Meta's explanation that Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Facebook post was removed "in error", with government sources telling PTI that the issue is "far from settled" and warrants deeper discussions.According to the sources, Meta's response is "not reasonable", and the government will continue engaging with the company over the incident as the issues is 'far from settled'.Later, giving more details, IT ministry Secretary S Krishnan telling ANI in an exclusive interview that the company's explanation of a "technical error" does not appear to be acceptable in its entirety.Krishnan said the removal of authorised content from the Prime Minister's verified handle was "extremely disturbing" and should never have happened. While he described Meta's unconditional apology as "a good step", but reiterated that the ministry was not fully convinced."What was done was wrong," Krishnan said, adding that Meta's claim that a technical glitch in its content-discovery algorithm caused the removal "does not appear to be an acceptable explanation in its entirety".He said the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) had sought further details from Meta and would hold a detailed technical meeting to determine exactly how the error occurred.Krishnan said the ministry would seek firm assurances from Meta that the accounts of prominent personalities in India are ring-fenced and that content posted from verified handles is not removed over "flimsy grounds" or algorithmic errors. "We will follow this up to see that there are systemic corrections to ensure that such instances do not recur," he said.The development comes after the ministry of electronics and information technology (MeitY) summoned Meta's global head of public policy following the removal of the Prime Minister's Facebook post. Meta had reportedly told govt that glitch in automated content filters caused the removal of video.The video, posted on July 23 during the Cockroach Janta Party-led student protests, featured PM Modi addressing the youth and promising stricter measures against examination paper leaks. It was briefly unavailable on Facebook before being restored.Responding to the controversy, a Meta spokesperson had said, "The content was removed in error and has since been restored."Read more: Meta cites 'error' after PM Modi's Facebook video briefly disappears The now-restored video featured Prime Minister Narendra Modi outlining the Centre's response to the NEET-UG controversy and promising stricter measures to curb examination paper leaks.Addressing students, Modi said the government would strengthen the legal framework to tackle paper leak cases. "I have issued directions to departments to set up Fast-Track Courts," Modi had said, adding that a draft legislation providing for stringent punishment and special courts to deal with paper leak cases would be discussed by the Cabinet before being introduced in Parliament.He also said the government had taken steps to ensure that the academic year of nearly 22 lakh students remained unaffected and reiterated that "nothing is more important than the welfare and future of our youth."The video was released amid nationwide protests over alleged examination irregularities and paper leaks.The Centre later introduced the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, 2026, proposing tougher penalties for offenders, including imprisonment of up to 10 years, higher fines and the creation of Special Fast-Track Courts for offences under the law.The agitation ended on July 25 after Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned from the Cabinet. The government also reached an agreement with the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and activist Sonam Wangchuk to withdraw cases against protesters, prevent police action against demonstrators and introduce stronger anti-paper leak legislation.The controversy also dominated the ongoing Monsoon Session of Parliament, with the Opposition demanding Pradhan's resignation and pressing for a detailed discussion on the NEET paper leak issue, leading to repeated disruptions in both Houses.
Article Summary: Govt says meta's response on briefly deleted video of pm was not enough. It ministry secretary s krishnan tells ani that the company's explanation of a "technical error" does not appear to be acceptable in its entirety. The now-restored video featured pm modi outlining the centre's response to the neet-ug controversy.

Article Title: Watch: Disturbing footage captures the moments after Chiefs OC Eric Bieniemy's son Elijah was taken into custody following Mia's shooting
Article Text:
Chilling footage captures the moments after Chiefs OC Eric Bieniemy's son Elijah was taken into custody following Mia's shooting(Image Via Getty)

New footage shows the tense police response after Elijah Bieniemy's arrest

Newly released bodycam footage has revealed the tense police response that followed the shooting involving Kansas City Chiefs offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy's family. The video, obtained and published by ABC 7 News, shows officers arriving at the scene, securing the home and taking Bieniemy's 27-year-old son, Elijah Bieniemy, into custody. While the footage does not show the shooting itself, it provides the clearest look yet at the chaotic moments that unfolded immediately afterward.The release of the video comes days after authorities confirmed that Mia Bieniemy, Eric Bieniemy's wife, survived the shooting after suffering gunshot wounds to her arm and chest. She remains in stable condition, while investigators continue working to determine what led to the incident.The bodycam footage runs for roughly four and a half minutes and begins with multiple officers arriving at what appears to be the Bieniemy family residence. Dressed in tactical gear and carrying rifles, officers carefully surround the entrance before making their way inside the home.After that, Elijah Bieniemy is seen outside in handcuffs as officers secure the area. The video then captures an ambulance arriving at the scene before paramedics wheel a stretcher into the residence.A short time later, emergency crews escort Mia Bieniemy out for medical treatment while officers continue locking down the neighborhood. The footage ends with investigators placing crime scene tape around the property as they begin collecting evidence.Authorities have since charged Elijah Bieniemy with malicious wounding, use of a firearm in the commission of a felony and discharging a firearm inside an occupied dwelling. Investigators have not released details about what may have led to the shooting, and the investigation remains active.The tragedy also brought immediate changes for the Kansas City Chiefs. Eric Bieniemy left training camp to be with his family, forcing the team to make a temporary coaching adjustment just weeks before the NFL season.Chiefs head coach Andy Reid addressed the situation during his post-practice press conference on July 27. Speaking to reporters after Bieniemy's departure from camp, Reid acknowledged the difficult circumstances facing his longtime assistant.He said, "Things happen. You just got to work through it, and that's where we're at right now. Time will have to be involved in this to help heal a little bit, but it'll all work out in the long run."With Bieniemy away from the team, Kansas City promoted pass game coordinator Joe Bleymaier to handle offensive coordinator duties on an interim basis. Reid stressed that the Chiefs fully support Bieniemy during this difficult period, with football taking a back seat as his family deals with the aftermath of the shooting. As of now, Mia is in stable condition.Currently, the newly released bodycam footage answers some questions about what happened after police reached the scene. At the same time, it also highlights just how quickly the situation unfolded. As the legal process moves forward and investigators continue gathering evidence, the focus remains on Mia Bieniemy's recovery and on the family at the center of one of the NFL's most heartbreaking stories of the offseason.
Article Summary: Chilling footage captures the moments after chiefs oc eric bieniemy's son elijah was taken into custody following mia's shooting. The video, obtained and published by abc 7 news, shows officers arriving at the scene and securing the home.

Article Title: Did police arrest Warren Hudson in Nolan Wells death probe? Here’s what we know so far
Article Text:
Did police arrest Warren Hudson in Nolan Wells death probe? Here’s what we know so far (Image via Getty)

Was Nolan Wells friend Warren Hudson arrested?

What investigators have said about Nolan Wells before he disappeared?

The investigation into Mississippi teenager Nolan Wells’ death is still ongoing, but false claims continue to spread online. A Facebook post recently claimed that Wells’ friend, Warren Hudson, had been arrested in connection with the case. However, there is no evidence to support that claim. As of July 29, no one has been arrested, and Hudson has not been named a suspect by investigators. Officials are still waiting for the state coroner’s final findings and the toxicology report, while an independent autopsy has also failed to determine the exact cause of Wells’ death.The latest rumour started with a Facebook post shared by an account called RJ Haddy. The post claimed that a witness had provided a photo showing Warren Hudson attacking Nolan Wells with a rock. It added, “This detail may explain the abnormal mark on the back of Nolan’s head from the autopsy,” and included a video that appeared to show a teenager being arrested.There is no proof to support those claims. The video shared in the post is unrelated to the Nolan Wells case, and no law enforcement agency has announced Hudson’s arrest. Hudson was among the group of friends who were with Wells on Horn Island before he disappeared on July 4.He was also seen in the last known video of the group on a boat. Because he was one of the last people seen with Wells, investigators questioned him during the investigation. However, officials have not identified him as a suspect.Authorities have continued to say they currently suspect the death was an accident, and they have found no signs of foul play. Even so, the investigation remains open as officials wait for the remaining reports.The case also saw another update after ABC News, citing a witness account contained in a Mississippi Department of Marine Resources document, reported that Nolan Wells had consumed alcohol heavily before his death.An earlier document from the same agency said Wells stayed behind on Horn Island while the rest of the teenagers returned on the boat. According to the document, the group told investigators “that when they left he was in the company of an unknown female and that he chose to remain at the island.”That account has become an important part of the timeline, but officials have not linked it to any criminal activity. The state coroner’s final report and toxicology findings are still pending, and investigators have not announced any new suspects or arrests.For now, the viral claims about Warren Hudson being taken into custody remain false. The investigation into Nolan Wells’ death is continuing, and authorities have urged the public to rely on verified information instead of unconfirmed social media posts.
Article Summary: A facebook post claimed that wells’ friend, warren hudson, had been arrested in connection with the case. There is no evidence to support that claim. Hudson was among the group of friends who were with wells on horn island before he disappeared on july 4. He was also seen in the last known video of the group on a boat.

Article Text:

New York linked to Tampa Bay’s Vita Vea in Dexter Lawrence II’s absence

Vita Vea is better than Packers’ defensive linemen

Vita Vea contract details with Tampa Bay Buccaneers

Vita Vea trade rumors

Category Details Player Vita Vea Current Team Tampa Bay Buccaneers Rumored Teams Chicago Bears, San Francisco 49ers, Los Angeles Rams, Los Angeles Chargers, Green Bay Packers, and New York Giants Contract Status 2026 is the last year of his 2021 contract Contract Value Vea signed a four-year, $71 million contract, including a $4 million signing bonus, $33 million in guaranteed money, with an average annual salary of $17 million Cap Hit In 2026, Vea is scheduled to earn a $17 million base salary while carrying a $22 million cap hit and a $6 million dead cap value Total Career Earnings $76 million over 8 NFL seasons Years Left On The Contract UFA in 2027, 1 year left.

Contract disputes are part and parcel of the offseason. This has happened with Dexter Lawrence and Taylor Decker before.And now it is happening with Tampa Bay Buccaneers veteran defensive tackle Vita Vea. Vea requested a trade after attempting to secure an extension with the Buccaneers. The team had selected him as the 12th overall pick in the 2018 NFL Draft.All these years, he played for them under two contracts. Twice, his contract was restructured to save Tampa Bay cap space. Under his current contract, he was going to become an unrestricted free agent in 2027 [next season].Like any other player, he asked for an extension before the current final season. But after failed attempts at a contract extension, he requested a trade. Analysts quickly came up with ideal landing spots for him. We’ll be discussing the Green Bay Packers and the New York Giants here.CBS Sports’ Carter Bahns suggests the New York Giants for Tampa Bay Buccaneers’ defensive lineman Vita Vea.The Giants traded their interior defensive lineman Dexter Lawrence II to the Cincinnati Bengals this offseason.Lawrence is a massive loss to New York in run defense. So, if they could go for Vea, they could reduce the impact of losing such a stout stopper.CBS Sports’ JP Acosta suggests the Green Bay Packers for Buccaneers DL Vita Vea. Heavy Sports’ Parker Hurley explains how Vea could fit into Green Bay.Vea recorded 17 sacks in the past three seasons. Devonte Wyatt, who is the highest-paid defensive lineman of the Packers, recorded 14.5 sacks in the past three seasons. Karl Brooks had 8 sacks in the same time frame. Javon Hargrave got injured in 2024 and has not been the same since.He is currently on the Physically Unable to Perform list. So, Vita Vea looks like the best run defender of the Packers group, if they trade for him.As per Spotrac, the 31-year-old Washington alum signed a four-year, $71 million contract with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in 2021. The deal included a $4 million signing bonus, $33 million in guaranteed money, and a $17 million average annual salary. In 2026, he is scheduled to earn a $17 million base salary while carrying a $22 million cap hit and a $6 million dead cap value.His contract was restructured twice. First, in March 2022, his $9.55 million 2022 base salary was converted into a signing bonus, clearing $7.64 million in cap space for Tampa Bay. Second, in March 2023, his $11.42 million 2023 salary was converted into a signing bonus with an added void year, clearing another $9.1 million in cap space.Michael Ginnitti, Co-Founder and Editor of Spotrac, posted on X on July 28 that if the Buccaneers trade defensive lineman Vita Vea, his new team will acquire a one-year, $18 million non-guaranteed deal.Consequently, the Buccaneers’ dead cap value would become $4 million in 2026 and $2 million in 2027. According to Spotrac’s model, Vea currently carries a $28 million market valuation.According to Spotrac’s calculated market value, Vita Vea is projected to sign a two-year, $55 million contract, which gives him a $27 million average annual income.
Article Summary: Green bay packers and new york giants heavily linked to $76m tampa bay buccaneers veteran tackle amid contract dispute. Vea requested a trade after attempting to secure an extension with the buccaneers. The 31-year-old washington alum signed a four-year, $71 million contract with the bucs in 2021.
